title: Phase 1 Study of VT-101 in Advanced Ovarian Cancer
official: A Phase 1 Dose-Finding, Safety, and Preliminary Clinical Activity Study of VT-101 in Advanced Ovarian Cancer
summary: This Phase 1, open-label study will evaluate VT-101, an investigational small-molecule therapy, in adult women with advanced, recurrent, or relapsed epithelial ovarian cancer. The primary objectives are to assess the safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetic profile of VT-101 and to identify a recommended dose for further study. Secondary and exploratory objectives include evaluation of preliminary antitumor activity and characterization of treatment-related effects in participants with limited standard treatment options.
criteria:
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Inclusion Criteria:

* Female participant
* Age ≥ 18 years
* Histologically confirmed advanced, recurrent, or relapsed epithelial ovarian cancer
* Has received prior standard therapy for ovarian cancer, OR has refused standard therapy, OR is intolerant to standard therapy, OR is not eligible for standard therapy
* ECOG Performance Status of 0, 1, or 2
* Adequate bone marrow, liver, and kidney function as defined by the protocol
* Able to comply with study procedures and provide informed consent
* For women of childbearing potential: agrees to use protocol-required contraception and meets pregnancy testing requirements

Exclusion Criteria (high-level):

* Does not meet the inclusion criteria
* Medical conditions or laboratory abnormalities that would make study participation unsafe
* Other protocol-defined exclusions as determined by the investigator

Sex:

• Female only

Age:

* 18 years and older
* No upper age limit specified

Healthy Volunteers:

* No
* Healthy volunteers are not eligible
* Participants must have advanced, recurrent, or relapsed epithelial ovarian cancer
